title: Clinician health alert
description: Health alert to clinicians in the form of a Health Alert Network message: category (alert, advisory or update), subject, summary, the case definition in use, numbered recommendations for clinicians, reporting instructions and contact. The category word is part of the format and is not changed.

examples: Measles case in Marston County: clinician actions
One confirmed measles case has been identified in a county resident. Clinicians should consider measles in patients with fever and rash.
Confirmed: acute febrile rash with laboratory confirmation. Probable: meets the clinical description with an epidemiologic link.
Isolate patients with suspected measles immediately.
Report suspected cases to the health department by phone the same day.
Call the Communicable Disease Program at (555) 014-2290 (24 hours).
Hospitals, urgent care centers, pediatric and family practices, school nurses
